detail: CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md 第 74 行称 operit-plugin-sdk 只依赖公开生态 crate，但其 Cargo.toml 的 [dependencies] 列出 operit-plugin-sdk-macros、operit-plugin-theme、operit-host-api、operit-util 四个内部 crate，文档声称与实现不符。
evidence: core/CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md:74 “operit-plugin-sdk depends only on public ecosystem crates.”；core/crates/plugin/sdk/Cargo.toml:13 operit-plugin-sdk-macros、:14 operit-plugin-theme、:18 operit-host-api、:19 operit-util。
title: operit-plugin-sdk 依赖声称与 Cargo.toml 不符

detail: CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md 第 126-128 行称 operit-js-bridge 用 QuickJsExecutionProvider 实现 JsExecutionProvider，但该名字在 operit-js-bridge 源码中不存在，实际实现是 HostJsExecutionProvider。
evidence: core/CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md:128 “QuickJsExecutionProvider”；core/crates/plugin/javascript-bridge/src/javascript/JsExecutionProvider.rs:16 “pub struct HostJsExecutionProvider”，:91 “impl JsExecutionProvider for HostJsExecutionProvider”。
title: QuickJsExecutionProvider 名字已不存在

detail: CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md 第 66 行规定子 crate 不得依赖 operit-runtime，但 operit-node-runtime 以可选依赖引用 operit-runtime（features 为 javascript）。
evidence: core/CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md:66 “Child crates must not depend on operit-runtime.”；core/crates/node/runtime/Cargo.toml:35 “operit-runtime = { path = "../../runtime/application", default-features = false, features = ["javascript"], optional = true }”。
title: operit-node-runtime 可选依赖 operit-runtime 违反文档规则

detail: CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md 第 90-91 行列出的 operit-node-edge 依赖是 operit-edge-contract、Host API、Link 与小型序列化/任务原语，未列出 operit-node-runtime，但 edge/sdk/node/Cargo.toml:10 明确依赖 operit-node-runtime。
evidence: core/CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md:90 “operit-node-edge depends on operit-edge-contract, Host API, Link, and small serialization/task primitives.”；edge/sdk/node/Cargo.toml:10 “operit-node-runtime = { path = "../../../core/crates/node/runtime", default-features = false, features = ["peer-runtime"] }”。
title: operit-node-edge 依赖列表漏了 operit-node-runtime

detail: CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md 第 92 行称 operit-proxy-edge 依赖 operit-edge-contract 与 Link，但 edge/sdk/proxy/Cargo.toml:12 还列出 operit-host-api。
evidence: core/CRATE_BOUNDARIES.md:92 “operit-proxy-edge depends on operit-edge-contract and Link.”；edge/sdk/proxy/Cargo.toml:12 “operit-host-api = { path = "../../../core/crates/foundation/host-api" }”。
title: operit-proxy-edge 依赖列表漏了 operit-host-api

detail: core/crates/README.md 第 5 行要求每个第二级 crate 目录都有自己的 Cargo.toml、src 与 README.md，但 node/peer-link、persistence/rescue、plugin/sdk-ipc、plugin/sdk-ipc-bridge、plugin/sdk-macros 共 5 个 crate 目录下没有 README.md。
evidence: core/crates/README.md:5 “Each second-level directory is an actual Cargo crate with its own Cargo.toml, src, and README.md.”；磁盘检查：29 个 crate 目录中 5 个缺 README.md。
title: 5 个 crate 目录缺 README.md
